/* Modified and verified for Y2k...Sobha...06/99 */
PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS
BEGIN

:global.program_version := '01'; -- valid_tests to valid_tests_don table;


default_value('','global.passwd');
execute_trigger('util_banner');
check_package_failure;

create_rg('CRG_VALID','C10');
check_package_failure;
set_item_property('toolbar.delete_record',ENABLED,property_false);
set_item_property('toolbar.clear_block',ENABLED,property_false);

:ctrl_block.local_chap_time:=lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_RECORD_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_record_check IS
 counter NUMBER:=0;
 chk NUMBER;
BEGIN
 
If :valid_hh_res_groups.group_code is not null then
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO counter
 FROM valid_hh_res_groups
 WHERE question_code=:ctrl_block.question_code and 
 group_code= :valid_hh_res_groups.group_code;
 
 --message('group='||:group_code||' counter='||to_char(counter));pause;
 
 If counter > 0 then 
 BELL;
 show_error('0319');
 End If;
End If;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EFF_TERM_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_eff_term_dates ( eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2 ) 
IS
dt_chk boolean;
local_date date;
begin
 
 local_date:=lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 
 /*if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 end if;
 */
 
 if eff_date < trunc(local_date) and from_where = 'E' then
 show_error('5015');
 end if;

 if term_date is not null then
 if term_date < trunc(local_date) then
 show_error('3115');
 end if;
 dt_chk := check_from_to_date(eff_date,term_date);
 if dt_chk then
 null;
 else
 --message('Err. Term date is before effective date.');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('5004');
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_CONTROL_BLOCK_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE set_control_block_items(action IN varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.QUESTION_CODE' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.QUESTION_CODE',action);
 end if;
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve',action);
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_QUESTION_CODE',action);
 if action = 'E' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_QUESTION_CODE',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 end if;
END;

PROCEDURE retrieve_data IS
chk boolean;
begin
if :ctrl_block.question_code is not null and :ctrl_block.response_code is not null then

 'question_code = :ctrl_block.question_code and response_code=:ctrl_Block.response_code');
end if;

go_block('valid_hh_res_groups');
:system.message_level:=10;
execute_query;
last_record;
first_record;
:system.message_level:=0;
If :valid_hh_res_groups.group_code is null then
 clear_block;
end if;

--set_block_property('valid_hh_res_groups',DEFAULT_WHERE,' ');
--go_block('valid_hh_res_groups');

end;
